node.title: DLI odd-phase polar-obstruction soundness
node.statement: If, for each actual DLI odd-evaluation phase on each relevant square-root component, a certificate identifies a pole of the Artin-Schreier-reduced phase with positive order not divisible by p, then the phase is not of Artin-Schreier form g^p-g+c.
node.attack_surface: formal local-pole obstruction to Artin-Schreier triviality
node.falsifier: a phase of Artin-Schreier form g^p-g+c whose reduced representative has a pole order prime to p
